title: Tree Item Alternative Branches Navigation
description: Extend tree items to support alternative branches with < > navigation to switch between them. Add alternatives field to TreeDataItem, implement branch navigation in TreeItem/DataItemView, and extend the default Tree storybook.
summary: Added alternative branches navigation to tree items. Extended TreeDataItem with `alternatives?: TreeDataItem[][]` field. Extended TreeItemProps with `branchCount`, `activeBranchIndex`, `onBranchChange` props. TreeItem renders < 1/N > navigation when branchCount > 0. DataItemView in Tree resolves child items from the active branch of alternatives. Added Alternatives story to Tree.stories.tsx with a multi-branch design tree example. Type-check, vitest (3/3), and storybook build all pass.
